item.title: Kumamoto Ramen — Guide
item.description: Kumamoto ramen is one of Kyushu’s classic regional ramen styles, a satisfying variation on the pork-bone (tonkotsu) tradition of southern Japan. Its broth is a rich, creamy tonkotsu, but often blended with chicken bones for a slightly milder, rounder flavour than the sharper Hakata style of Fukuoka. What truly sets it apart is the generous use of garlic: fragrant black or brown ‘mayu’ (fried garlic oil) drizzled on top, plus crispy fried garlic chips, giving the bowl a deep, toasty, aromatic richness.
